connector.name: Forge Cascade MCP Memory Server
connector.registryDescription: AI memory buyer routing with Forge docs, pricing, paid recommendations, and MCP discovery.
connector.summary: Hosted at forgecascade.org over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the container image forge-cascade-mcp:v0.1.7. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the sunflash12 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
